bookings_requested_range.name: bookings_requested_range
bookings_requested_range.value: "bookings"."requested_ends_at" IS NULL OR "bookings"."requested_starts_at" IS NULL OR "bookings"."requested_ends_at" > "bookings"."requested_starts_at"

bookings_cancelled_fields.name: bookings_cancelled_fields
bookings_cancelled_fields.value: "bookings"."status" NOT IN ('cancelled_by_customer', 'cancelled_by_business') OR "bookings"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL

visits_marked_complete_fields.name: visits_marked_complete_fields
visits_marked_complete_fields.value: "visits"."status" NOT IN ('completed_pending_confirmation', 'disputed', 'fix_scheduled', 'completed') OR "visits"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL

visits_cancelled_fields.name: visits_cancelled_fields
visits_cancelled_fields.value: "visits"."status" NOT IN ('cancelled_by_customer', 'cancelled_by_business') OR "visits"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL

services_price_matches_pricing_type.name: services_price_matches_pricing_type
services_price_matches_pricing_type.value: ("services"."pricing_type" = 'fixed' AND "services"."price_cents" IS NOT NULL) OR ("services"."pricing_type" = 'quote' AND "services"."price_cents" IS NULL)

disputes_resolved_fields.name: disputes_resolved_fields
disputes_resolved_fields.value: ("disputes"."status" = 'resolved') = ("disputes"."resolution" IS NOT NULL AND "disputes"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL)

payments_awaiting_payout_idx.name: payments_awaiting_payout_idx
payments_awaiting_payout_idx.where: "payments"."payout_id" IS NULL AND "payments"."released_at" IS NOT NULL

payments_one_live_per_visit_uidx.name: payments_one_live_per_visit_uidx
payments_one_live_per_visit_uidx.where: "payments"."visit_id" IS NOT NULL AND "payments"."status" NOT IN ('failed', 'cancelled')
